name: shworks-devkit
description: Reusable local development toolkit and MCP server

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @shworks/local-core build && pnpm --filter @shworks/local-mcp build && pnpm --filter @shworks/local-cli build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @shworks/local-core typecheck && pnpm --filter @shworks/local-mcp typecheck && pnpm --filter @shworks/local-cli typecheck
